historical_context.time_period: Pallas Species Strikes era, 2719-2724; the exact shift is story-local.
historical_context.location: The claimshare kiosk at the spoke-side shift gate of Service Ring Kappa, Pallas Bloom Cluster.
historical_context.summary: A missed actuator lease payment moves through diagnostics, certification, insurance, freight, and claimshare access before AU asks the same workers to restore the value of their compensation through another hazardous cycle.

public_facts.text: AU ramps bind future-production claims, maintenance budgets, berths, shifts, freight, and recognition under temporary administration.
Claimshares create project-local priority but are not equity; their usefulness depends on the ramp remaining recognized, supplied, and open.
Kappa's seal-lung and bypass maintenance protects industrial open air through a mixed labor ecology whose suppliers retain separate liability categories.

ambient_pressures.text: Separate counterparties can each protect one contract while workers and households absorb their combined status changes.
A cephalopod support cartridge can be body support, work equipment, supplier property, and a frozen settlement claim at once.
Cross-category household books can preserve food, clinic accompaniment, cartridges, and repair time without importing machinery or forgiving AU's debt.

author_only_boundaries.text: Miri, Oru, Sef, Kara, the exact actuator default, and every branch outcome are fixture-local draft elements.
The lore patch establishes the cascade and household books but not universal priority thresholds, notice language, or external enforceability.
The scene is hard pre-Elysium institutional science fiction; no post-Elysium physics enters it.
